description:
🛡️ Get Spam-Free Health Insurance Advice from Ditto Insurance 👇
https://ditto.sh/7z6ceu

I spent weeks going through 18 health insurance policies — calling companies, checking policy wordings, running the numbers — so you don't have to.18 went in. 6 came out.In this video I cover:

How to think about health insurance (most people have the wrong mental model)
The 3-metric framework I used to screen 31 insurers
Why government insurers are a long-term risk
The 6-filter policy test that eliminated most policies
Why ICICI Elevate, Niva Bupa Reassure and Care Supreme didn't make the cut
The 6 policies worth buying in 2026 — with exact premiums for a family of three
How to get 1 crore cover for ₹14,000 a year using an aggregate deductible
The one policy nobody is talking about

📊 Download the full comparison sheet (all 31 companies, all 18 policies, all premiums): https://substack.com/home/post/p-193262796

Couple of points I came across regarding aggregate deductible are these. Please do your own fact check as I relied a bit on Google Gemini rather than policy document. 

1. No Cashless claim Process: Policies with deductibles may be restricted to reimbursement only, meaning no cashless facility even at network hospitals.

2. Permanence of deductible: For policyholders over 50, the choice of a deductible is supposedly permanent and cannot be removed in future renewals. Removing a deductible is considered an "enhancement of risk" for the insurer.
